proposed_rules.trigger: A zone with a short caption (e.g. 'Test a live app') but disproportionate height, suggesting an embedded interactive app/iframe was not captured by the minWidth snapshot.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM extraction to identify the embed and model as an 'app-embed' block, rather than treating the caption alone as the section's content. Rejected alternative: accept the short caption as the full content (would drop the interactive demo).
proposed_rules.rationale: Height/content mismatch is a strong signal of lazy-loaded/iframe content invisible to the current capture method.
